newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-KIEFER THROUGH TO GERMAN OPEN SECOND ROUND.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KIEFER THROUGH TO GERMAN OPEN SECOND ROUND.

text.p: Promising German Nicolas Kiefer beat Italy's Marzio Martelli on Tuesday to go through to the second-round of the German Open where he will meet his teacher Boris Becker.
Kiefer fought the match of his life to win 4-6 7-6 (7-4) 6-2 and said he was confident for his match against Becker, who has been coaching the 19-year-old member of the German junior team.
"Of course I want to win," he said.
But the former Wimbledon champion said he still had a few lessons for Kiefer. "I hope I can show Kiefer on the court what I could only say to him in words up until now," said Becker.
When the match between the two generations of German tennis will take place is still uncertain as rain forced organisers to abandon most of Tuesday's schedule.

Czech Slava Dosedel beat Italy's Renzo Furlan 7-6 (7-5) 6-2 to go through to the second round and Marcello Craca triumphed over fellow-German Marc Goellner 6-4 6-3, before heavy rain halted the rest of the day's play.
